column1: # The six things that must work before launch.
# One row per launch blocker. The scorecard reads the latest run of <workflow>
# in <repo> and reports PASS / FAIL / NOT_BUILT. A blocker with no workflow is
# NOT_BUILT: an exit test that nothing can run is not an exit test.
# Every exit test must run WITHOUT staging or prod, so that a torn-down estate
# cannot hide a regression. Use kind, `terraform plan`, a rendered chart, or a
# Say what it means in ENGLISH in the `plain` column. Anyone reading the board —
# owner or agent — must understand the row without decoding a metaphor.
# This file is public. A row that passes states the control that holds, in the
# present tense. A row that fails states what is missing. No row describes how
# to break the live service: the exit test proves the control, and the board
#   n  name  repo  workflow  root_issue  plain  exit_test

column6: The script that builds the AWS environment runs clean. This test fails a plan that grows a dependency cycle or that wants to delete the audit-log or backup buckets.
column7: terraform plan on bootstrap/eks/gibson exits 0 with no S3 bucket in the replace set

column6: A new customer never receives the verification email, so nobody can sign up.
column7: an address receives the verification mail and the account reaches a Ready workspace with no manual DB touch

column6: A restore has now been rehearsed end to end, and it runs again every day. It is what stands between a dead disk and losing every tenant's encryption keys.
column7: an OpenBao snapshot lands in S3 and a restore into a clean cluster reads a tenant key back

column6: Each customer is rate-limited on its own. The edge sees the real client address, so one client cannot slow the API for another.
column7: one client hits the rate limit while a second client keeps working

column6: Production runs the exact chart digest that staging tested. The promotion step verifies the signature and the digest, and it blocks a mismatch.
column7: prod runs the chart digest staging tested and promote-verify blocks a mismatch

column6: Every step of one agent session runs in the same sandbox. The agent keeps its own work between steps.
column7: two tool calls in one session reach the same microVM and see the same worktree
